explanation: Evaluate the rounded scale limit. This limit supplies the rounded root exponent used to determine the actual band size and the remaining number of bands.
theorem_title: Logarithmic rate of the band root
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BandScales.bandRoot_log_rate :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BandScales.bandRoot n : ℝ) / Real.log n) atTop
      (𝓝 (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Parameters.epsilon * _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Parameters.E)) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
The integer band-root scale satisfies $$\frac{\log(\operatorname{bandRoot}(n))}{\log n}\longrightarrow\varepsilon E$$ as $n\to\infty$, for the fixed schedule constants $\varepsilon,E$.

This limit supplies the rounded root exponent used to determine the actual band size and the remaining number of bands.
